thig14.1:1.1: samatto. || Jīvakambavanaṃ rammaṃ gacchantiṃ bhikkhuniṃ Subhaṃ | dhuttako saṃnivāresi tam enaṃ abravī Subhā. || ||
thig14.1:2.1: kiṃ te aparādhitaṃ mayā yaṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi | na hi pabbajitāya āvuso puriso saṃphusanāya kappati. || ||
thig14.1:3.1: garuke mama satthu sāsane yā sikkhā sugatena desitā | parisuddhapadaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi. || ||
thig14.1:4.1: āvilacitto anāvilaṃ sarajo vītarajaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ | sabbattha vimuttamānasaṃ kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi. || ||
thig14.1:5.1: daharā ca apāpikā c' asi kiṃ te pabbajjā karissati | nikkhipa kāsāyacīvaraṃ ehi ramāmase pupphite vane. || ||
thig14.1:6.1: madhurañ ca pavanti sabbaso kusumarajena samuddhatā dumā | paṭhamavasanto sukho utu ehi ramāmase pupphite vane. || ||
thig14.1:7.1: kusumitasikharā ca pādapā abhigajjanti va māluteritā | kā tuyhaṃ rati bhavissati yadi ekā vanam ogāhissasi. || ||
thig14.1:8.1: vāḷamigasaṅghasevitaṃ kuñjaramattakareṇuloḷitaṃ | asahāyikā gantum icchasi rahitaṃ bhīsanakaṃ mahāvanaṃ. || ||
thig14.1:9.1: tapanīyakatā va dhītikā vicarasi Cittarathe va accharā | kāsikasukhumehi vagguhi sobhasi vasanehi 'nūpame. || ||
thig14.1:10.1: ahaṃ tava vasānugo siyaṃ yadi viharemasi kānanantare | na hi m' atthi tayā piyataro pāṇo kinnarimandalocane. || ||
thig14.1:11.1: yadi me vacanaṃ karissasi sukhitā ehi agāram āvasa | pāsādanivātavāsinā parikamman te karontu nāriyo. || ||
thig14.1:12.1: kāsikasukhumāni dhāraya abhiropehi ca mālavaṇṇakaṃ | kañcanamaṇimuttakaṃ bahuṃ vividhaṃ ābharaṇaṃ karomi te. || ||
thig14.1:13.1: sudhotarajapacchadaṃ subhaṃ gonakatūlikasantataṃ navaṃ | abhirūha sayanaṃ mahārahaṃ candanamaṇḍitaṃ sāragandhikaṃ. || ||
thig14.1:14.1: uppalaṃ ca udakato ubbhataṃ yathā yaṃ amanussasevitaṃ | evaṃ tuvaṃ brahmacārini sakesu aṅgesu jaraṃ gamissasi. || ||
thig14.1:15.1: kin te idha sārasammataṃ kuṇapapūramhi susānavaḍḍhane | bhedanadhamme kaḷevare yaṃ disvā vimano dikkhasi. || ||
thig14.1:16.1: akkhīni ca turiyā-r-iva kinnariyā-r-iva pabbatantare | tava me nayanāni dakkhiya bhiyyo kāmarati pavaḍḍhati. || ||
thig14.1:17.1: uppalasikharopamānite vimale hāṭakasannibhe mukhe | tava me nayanāni dakkhiya bhiyyo kāmaguṇo pavaḍḍhati. || ||
thig14.1:18.1: api dūragatā saremhase āyatapamhe visuddhadassane | na hi m' atthi tayā piyatarā nayanā kinnarimandalocane. || ||
thig14.1:19.1: apathena payātum icchasi candaṃ kīḷanakaṃ gavesasi | Meruṃ laṅghetum icchasi yo tvaṃ buddhasutaṃ maggayasi. || ||
thig14.1:20.1: n' atthi hi loke sadevake rāgo yattha pi dāni me siyā | na pi naṃ jānāmi kīriso atha maggena hato samūlako. || ||
thig14.1:21.1: iṅghāḷakhuyā va ujjhito visapatto-r-iva aggato kato | na pi naṃ passāmi kīriso atha maggena hato samūlako. || ||
thig14.1:22.1: yassā siyā apaccavekkhitaṃ satthā vā anusāsito siyā | tvaṃ tādisikaṃ palobhaya jānantiṃ so imaṃ vihaññasi. || ||
thig14.1:23.1: mayhaṃ hi akkuṭṭhavandite sukhadukkhe ca sati upaṭṭhitā | saṅkhatam asubhan ti jāniya sabbatth' eva mano na limpati. || ||
thig14.1:24.1: sāhaṃ sugatassa sāvikā maggaṭṭhaṅgikayānayāyinī | uddhaṭasallā anāsavā suññāgāragatā ramām' ahaṃ. || ||
thig14.1:25.1: diṭṭhā hi mayā sucittitā sombhā dārukacillakā navā | tantihi ca khīlakehi ca vinibaddhā vividhaṃ panaccitā. || ||
thig14.1:26.1: tamh' uddhaṭe tantikhīlake visaṭṭhe vikale paripakkate | avinde khaṇḍaso kate kimhi tattha manaṃ nivesaye. || ||
thig14.1:27.1: tathūpamaṃ dehakāni maṃ tehi dhammehi vinā na vattanti | dhammehi vinā na vattanti kimhi tattha manaṃ nivesaye. || ||
thig14.1:28.1: yathā haritālena makkhitaṃ addasa cittikaṃ bhittiyā kataṃ | tamhi te viparītadassanaṃ paññā mānusikā niratthikā. || ||
thig14.1:29.1: māyaṃ viya aggato kataṃ supinante vasuvaṇṇapādapaṃ | upadhāvasi andha rittakaṃ janamajjhe-r-iva rupparūpakaṃ. || ||
thig14.1:30.1: vaṭṭani-r-iva koṭar' ohitā majjhebubbuḷakā sāssukā | pīḷikoḷikā c' ettha jāyati vividhā cakkhuvidhā 'va piṇḍitā. || ||
thig14.1:31.1: uppāṭiya cārudassanā na ca pajjittha asaṅgamānasā | handa te cakkhuṃ harassu taṃ tassa narassa adāsi tāvade. || ||
thig14.1:32.1: tassa ca viramāsi tāvade rāgo tattha khamāpayi ca naṃ | sotthi siyā brahmacārini na puno edisakaṃ bhavissati. || ||
thig14.1:33.1: āhaniya edisaṃ janaṃ aggiṃ pajjalitaṃ va liṅgiya | gaṇhissaṃ āsīvisaṃ viya api nu sotthi siyā khamehi no. || ||
thig14.1:34.1: muttā ca tato sā bhikkhunī agami buddhavarassa santikaṃ | passiya varapuññalakkhaṇaṃ cakkhu āsi yathāpurāṇakan ti. || ||
